$comment: Per-environment runtime config, written to site-config.json by tools/scripts/prepare-hosting.mjs --site-config. Development uses Cloudflare's public always-pass Turnstile test key. null disables a feature's live path (the contact form falls back to email, the Orbit lab to its bundled snapshot). n8nUrl is the self-hosted n8n for StudyLM and ChatPulse; production takes it from the N8N_URL environment variable (a CI secret), so the tunnel address stays out of the repository. learningEdgeUrl is the Learning Engine's edge Worker (wrangler dev serves it on :8787; tools/scripts/learning-setup.mjs deploys it, ADR-0024). assistantUrl is the assistants' edge Worker (wrangler dev serves it on :8788; CI deploys it, ADR-0031). syncUrl is the sync Worker (wrangler dev serves it on :8789; CI deploys it once its D1 database exists, ADR-0032). lasertagUrl is BARQ's Worker (wrangler dev serves it on :8790; CI deploys it once its D1 database exists, ADR-0033).
